title: Skubal returns to Detroit in Dodgers uniform
dek: Tarik Skubal pitched at Comerica Park on Friday night for the Los Angeles Dodgers against the Detroit Tigers, his former team. It marked Skubal's 78th appearance at the ballpark but his first while wearing another team's uniform after Detroit parted ways with him at the deadline.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Skubal pitched at Comerica Park for the 78th time in his career on Friday night, but for the first time in a Dodgers uniform after the Tigers traded him at the deadline.
bottom_line: Watch Skubal's performance metrics in the Dodgers' remaining contests as a barometer of his fit with the team in their pennant push. The open question is whether his tenure in Los Angeles alters his stated openness to a future return to Detroit.
body: Tarik Skubal pitched at Comerica Park on Friday night for the Los Angeles Dodgers against the Detroit Tigers, marking his 78th career appearance at the ballpark but his first in another team's uniform. Skubal spent seven years with the Tigers before Detroit parted ways with him at the deadline, per Sporting News.

Skubal wore road grays in Detroit for the first time, a visual shift that underscored the transaction that sent him to Los Angeles. According to Sporting News, Skubal has not ruled out the possibility of a return to Detroit at a future point in his career.

The game took place against the backdrop of his emotional connection to the ballpark where he developed as a professional, though the available reporting does not detail his performance statistics from Friday's outing or the final game result.
